parameters.name: ChargingTime
parameters.tips:
1.Only filling the four period settings with all zero can disable force-charge period.
2.The following two checkboxes means:
 (checked) During force-charge period, both grid and PV can charge battery.
 (unchecked) During force-charge period, only PV can charge battery.

properties.name: SgReadyStartPower
properties.tips: StartPower should be 5000W or more larger than StopPower

properties.name: BalanceLoad
properties.tips:
Note: Unbalanced load function
Enable: activate unbalanced load function.  Disable: deactivate the function.

properties.name: BalanceLogicFirst
properties.tips: Enable: grid power will be balanced.  Disable: grid power will be unbalanced.
